# Test issuegraph dep remove command
issuegraph init --prefix test

# Create issues and capture their hash IDs
issuegraph create 'First issue'
cp stdout first.txt
exec sh -c 'grep -oE "test-[a-z0-9]+" first.txt > first_id.txt'

issuegraph create 'Second issue'
cp stdout second.txt
exec sh -c 'grep -oE "test-[a-z0-9]+" second.txt > second_id.txt'

# Add dependency
exec sh -c 'issuegraph dep add $(cat second_id.txt) $(cat first_id.txt)'
stdout 'Added dependency'

# Remove dependency
exec sh -c 'issuegraph dep remove $(cat second_id.txt) $(cat first_id.txt)'
stdout 'Removed dependency'

# Verify dependency is gone
exec sh -c 'issuegraph show $(cat second_id.txt) | grep -v "Depends on"'
